test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If Akash can do a piece of work in 63 days and Disha can do the same work in 84 days. They worked together for 12 days and after this Disha left the work and Akash completed the remaining work, then find the total number of days required to finish the work.
solution:
**Given:**

Akash can do a piece of work in 63 days.

Disha can do the same work in 84 days.

**Concept:**

Total work = Time × Efficiency

**Solution:**

Total work = LCM(63, 84) = 252 units&l
